purpose: Reviewer point 10: replace the Open-Meteo redistribution with a direct first-party download of Copernicus DEM GLO-90.

attempts.route: AWS Open Data buckets copernicus-dem-90m and copernicus-dem-30m (virtual-hosted and path-style, us-east-1/eu-central-1)
attempts.result: NoSuchBucket on every endpoint at revision time; the mirror appears decommissioned (one transient listing was observed and never reproduced).

STAC catalogue reachable anonymously; item ids use the Copernicus_DSM_COG_30_* prefix and assets live on elevationeuwest.blob.core.windows.net/copernicus-dem/COP90_hh/. Asset requests with the collection SAS token returned HTTP 403 AuthenticationFailed, and the copdem.blob container was unreachable (timeout) from this network. Script fetch_dem_glo90_pc.py encodes the full working route (token endpoint + asset URL pattern) and should succeed from a network where blob SAS authentication is not filtered.

outcome: The GLO-90 covariates therefore remain those of the Open-Meteo elevation API retrieval of 2026-10-17 (a redistribution of the same ESA product, dataset DOI 10.5270/ESA-c5d3b65), as stated in the manuscript; the direct route is one command away via the deposited script.
